stories.title: Denmark Crushes Ronaldo-Less Portugal Four-One in Nations League
stories.summary:
Portugal suffered a heavy 4-1 defeat against Denmark in their UEFA Nations League Group A4 fixture at the Municipal Stadium of Braga. The match on Saturday marked Portugal's first outing without Cristiano Ronaldo following his recent retirement from international football. Rasmus Hojlund delivered a stellar performance for Denmark, scoring two goals as the team moved into second place in the group with nine points from five games.

Before kickoff, Portugal honored Ronaldo by having all players and mascots wear his famous number seven and name on their jerseys, while fans displayed a large banner reading "Thank you, captain." Ronaldo retired after a 30-day suspension and a dispute with coach Jorge Jesus, leaving his international career capped at 146 goals in 234 matches since his 2003 debut.

Denmark dominated the encounter from the start, opening the scoring just before halftime through Pierre-Emile Hojbjerg's penalty in the 43rd minute. Hojlund extended the lead with a volley shortly after the restart and then outmaneuvered Ruben Dias to score a powerful shot from the edge of the box. Joachim Andersen added a fourth goal with a header before Bernardo Silva scored a late consolation for the home side.

In the group's other match, Norway defeated Wales 3-1 in Oslo thanks to goals from Antonio Nusa, Andreas Schjelderup, and Erling Haaland. The result left Craig Bellamy's Wales at the bottom of the group and facing potential relegation. Meanwhile, Portugal had already secured qualification for the quarter-finals prior to this match.

stories.title: UN Official Urges Immediate Fertilizer Shipments Through Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary:
A high-ranking United Nations official has called on Iran and the United States to swiftly permit fertilizer shipments to pass through the Strait of Hormuz. Jorge Moreira da Silva, who leads the UN Office for Project Services, delivered the appeal at the COP31 climate talks located in Antalya, Turkey. He emphasized that resolving this specific supply bottleneck is crucial to preventing millions of individuals from sliding into severe poverty.

The critical waterway has experienced severe shipping disruptions following an Iranian blockade, which was initiated in the wake of a joint United States-Israeli military operation against Iran during late February. Further complications arose due to separate American blockades targeting Iranian ports. Moreira da Silva clarified that while both nations should continue pursuing comprehensive peace negotiations, they must simultaneously agree to an immediate, exceptional, limited, and time-bound exception specifically for fertilizer transport.

According to the UN task force leader, the logistics demand is relatively modest, requiring approximately five vessels daily to navigate the strait. Historically, the route handled one-third of the global fertilizer supply, but regional blockades have since driven prices upward by 30 percent. Developing nations are bearing the heaviest burden, with Sudan reporting doubled food prices over a six-month period and Nepali farmers facing severe affordability crises.

Vulnerable populations across Mozambique, Kenya, Sudan, Somalia, Nepal, Bangladesh, and Sri Lanka are encountering profound agricultural challenges as a direct consequence of the shortage. Moreira da Silva cautioned that missing upcoming planting seasons globally could expose 45 million people to acute food insecurity and force 30 million individuals into poverty. The United Nations has operational systems prepared to mobilize these essential fertilizer shipments within seven to ten days if permitted.

stories.title: China and US Hold Trade Council Discussions Regarding Tariffs and Agriculture
stories.summary:
Trade representatives from China and the United States have convened their inaugural trade council meeting in Beijing to deliberate on tariff reductions and agricultural commerce. The discussions occurred on Friday, just days prior to an anticipated summit between national leaders scheduled for the following week in Shenzhen. China’s Commerce Ministry characterized the dialogues as candid, in-depth, and constructive, though officials did not disclose whether any formal accords were finalized during the session.

The agenda featured reviews of previous economic agreements, encompassing a proposed reciprocal thirty billion dollar for thirty billion dollar tariff-reduction arrangement, agricultural trade exchanges, and other matters of mutual interest. Both governments committed to utilizing the newly established council framework to address outstanding trade friction and foster ongoing economic cooperation. The ongoing talks follow a September summit held in Washington between Presidents Xi Jinping and Donald Trump.

During the Washington summit, both administrations outlined a sixty billion dollar package of reciprocal tariff cuts, which included approximately seventeen billion dollars in American agricultural commodities imported by China throughout 2024. However, implementation of this comprehensive plan remains pending. Recent customs data analyzed by Reuters indicates that Chinese purchases of American farm products, excluding soybeans, are tracking toward a seven-year low for the current year, highlighting lingering instability surrounding bilateral trade commitments.

Beijing has consistently pressed Washington to enact the previously discussed sixty billion dollar tariff reduction framework as an essential prerequisite for escalating purchases of American agricultural goods. Meanwhile, White House officials confirmed that President Trump is scheduled to meet with President Xi on Thursday. The high-level encounter will take place on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum hosted in Shenzhen.

stories.title: Bank of England Chief Economist Signals More Rate Hikes Ahead in 2027
stories.summary:
Bank of England Chief Economist Huw Pill stated that the central bank will likely need to implement further interest rate increases throughout 2027. Speaking in an interview with the Financial Times published on Saturday, Pill noted that additional tightening will be necessary beyond any potential adjustment at the upcoming December meeting to effectively control domestic inflation.

The central bank recently increased its benchmark interest rate from 3.75 percent to 4 percent during its November gathering, marking the first upward adjustment since August 2023. Pill described that decision as a notable step forward in positioning monetary policy appropriately, but cautioned that additional measures remain required. He emphasized that anticipated evidence of persistent price pressures will motivate subsequent rate hikes next year, driven heavily by second-round effects stemming from elevated energy expenses.

British inflation is projected to climb toward approximately 5 percent by the middle of next year, representing more than double the official central bank target of 2 percent. This anticipated surge is largely attributed to wage-related second-round effects connected to the ongoing conflict involving Iran. Pill indicated that a peaceful resolution to the US-Israeli conflict with Iran and a subsequent drop in energy costs remain highly unlikely, cementing his expectation to vote for another quarter-point rate increase next month.

Financial markets currently project roughly 90 basis points of total monetary tightening by the end of 2027, bringing borrowing costs near the 5 percent threshold. Pill remarked that these market expectations are realistic, noting that earlier delays in raising rates have reduced the feasibility of modest adjustments. Additionally, Pill announced that he does not intend to pursue a third term as the bank's chief economist when his current tenure concludes in September 2027.

stories.title: Pakistan and Muslim Nations Condemn Israeli Airstrike on Gaza Hospital
stories.summary:
Pakistan alongside sixteen other Muslim nations has issued a stern condemnation regarding an Israeli airstrike targeting the Nasser Medical Complex located in Gaza. The coalition warned that ongoing military actions against Palestinian civilians and persistent restrictions on humanitarian assistance are actively jeopardizing existing ceasefire arrangements and deepening an already severe humanitarian emergency as winter approaches. The joint declaration was formally released by Pakistan’s Foreign Office on Saturday.

The condemnation was endorsed by the foreign ministers of Pakistan, Algeria, Djibouti, Egypt, Indonesia, Jordan, Kuwait, Lebanon, Libya, Mauritania, Oman, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Somalia, Sudan, Turkiye, and the United Arab Emirates. The diplomats strongly denounced the strike on the medical facility in Khan Younis, which resulted in casualties among patients and healthcare workers, citing direct violations of international humanitarian law that guarantee special protections to medical infrastructure. Furthermore, the officials criticized ongoing strikes targeting displaced persons sheltering in tents across Gaza.

The participating ministers expressed profound concern that continued limits on humanitarian access, medical supplies, and essential shelter materials—such as tents, caravans, and mobile homes—are severely worsening conditions ahead of freezing winter temperatures. Inadequate living conditions and compromised sanitation systems place vulnerable civilians, particularly infants and children, at extreme risk of exposure and illness. The coalition urged Israel to immediately fulfill its obligations under the Sharm El-Sheikh Agreement, President Trump’s Comprehensive Plan, and United Nations Security Council Resolution 2803 (2025).

To preserve the credibility of ongoing peace agreements and reinforce the ceasefire, the foreign ministers called upon the United States and the Board of Peace to intensify diplomatic pressure on Israel. They demanded the complete lifting of all barriers restricting the flow of aid, allowing United Nations agencies and humanitarian organizations to operate without political or security interference. The coalition reaffirmed its collective commitment to working with international partners to ensure the full execution of all phases of the peace plan and to alleviate the suffering of the Palestinian population.

stories.title: Opposition Leaders Approach Federal Constitutional Court for Release of KP Chief Minister
stories.summary:
Opposition leaders in Pakistan have formally approached the Federal Constitutional Court to demand the release of non-functional Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi and several other political figures. The joint petition was filed on Saturday by National Assembly Opposition Leader Mehmood Khan Achakzai and Senate Opposition Leader Raja Nasir Abbas. Additional petitions have been submitted by PTI MNA Shandana Gulzar and PTI Chairman Barrister Gohar Ali Khan, who sought to join the legal proceedings.

The case is being handled by a two-member bench led by Chief Justice Amin-ud-Din Khan and Justice Aamir Farooq. The bench is scheduled to resume hearings on Monday, November 16, reviewing appeals filed by the KP Additional Chief Secretary and the Secretary of the Home and Tribal Affairs Department against earlier Peshawar High Court orders. Previously, the bench had suspended those high court rulings issued under Article 199 in relation to Article 245 of the Constitution.

The petition names various federal and provincial authorities as respondents, including the secretaries of interior and defence, the KP chief secretary, and the director general of the Federal Investigation Agency. It seeks the enforcement of fundamental rights against what it terms unlawful detentions of Afridi, provincial assembly speaker Babar Saleem Swati, and numerous other provincial and national assembly members. The legal action demands the disclosure of their detention sites and their immediate production before the court.

Furthermore, the filing raises broad constitutional questions regarding executive authority under Articles 232, 234, and 245, alongside fundamental protections concerning liberty and political association. It argues that arbitrary state actions targeting elected officials undermine democratic mandates and democratic representation in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa. The applicants ask the court to reaffirm constitutional supremacy and protect the rights of opposition politicians against political victimisation.

stories.title: Security Forces Eliminate 24 Terrorists While Four Soldiers Die in Operations
stories.summary:
Pakistani security forces killed 24 terrorists in a series of intelligence-based operations conducted across North Waziristan and Balochistan. The engagements, however, also resulted in the martyrdom of four military personnel, including an army major. The Inter-Services Public Relations detailed the operations in official statements, noting that the casualties among militants included two Afghan nationals and a suicide bomber.

In North Waziristan, operations targeted militant locations in Mir Ali, Datta Khel, and surrounding areas. Over a twelve-hour period of intense fire exchanges, 12 terrorists were neutralized in Ali Khel, with two additional militants killed in each of the other targeted zones. The military identified these individuals as members of the Fitna-al-Khwarij network, which officials linked to Indian support. During these clashes, Havildar Asmat Ali and Naik Aftab Ali lost their lives, while security forces successfully recovered weapons and ammunition.

Concurrently, operations in Balochistan began on November 13 around Kolpur, Kardagap, and Nushki to secure the Quetta–Taftan National Highway for civilian transit. In Kolpur, security forces killed eight terrorists, including a suicide bomber, belonging to the group designated as Fitna-al-Hindustan. A separate incident on November 14 involved militants attacking military patrol vehicles with armed quadcopters, resulting in the deaths of Major Omer Minhas Nasir and Havaldar Muhammad Adnan Khan.

The military accused hostile intelligence agencies, specifically pointing to India, of providing financial and technological backing, such as drones and improvised explosive devices, to aid these militant groups. Despite the evolving threats and the use of advanced technology by insurgents, the military affirmed that counterterrorism efforts and clearance operations will persist until all threats are eradicated.

stories.title: Pakistan Appoints Musadik Malik to Represent Country at New Delhi SCO Dialogue
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government has selected Federal Minister for Climate Change and Environmental Coordination Dr Musadik Masood Malik to attend an upcoming international diplomatic event in India. He will travel to New Delhi to represent Pakistan at the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation Civilisational Dialogue.

The high-level gathering is scheduled to take place from November 20 to 22, 2026. It serves as a platform for delegates from member states of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation to convene and discuss matters concerning cultural understanding and civilisational exchange.

stories.title: Microsoft Declares Global Service Outage Fully Resolved Following Extensive Disruption
stories.summary:
Technology corporation Microsoft announced on Saturday that it has successfully restored services to all customers worldwide, officially concluding a major global outage. The company stated via social media that it finished addressing the root cause of the technical incident and brought back online all remaining impacted regions and users.

The massive disruption began on Thursday, knocking Microsoft products offline across at least 74 countries and territories in the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa, as tracked by Downdetector. The disruption severely affected critical communication and productivity tools, including Outlook email, the Teams communication platform, and the Copilot artificial intelligence assistant. Microsoft previously reported a broad recovery for Outlook and other tools by Friday, clarifying that the stoppage stemmed from elevated infrastructure loads rather than any cyberattack or artificial intelligence malfunction.

Alongside the restoration announcement, Microsoft issued a warning regarding a separate security risk. The company detected an active phishing campaign exploiting the confusion caused by the outage. Fraudulent emails mimicking official service notifications were sent to users, falsely claiming that emails blocked during the service interruption would be permanently deleted unless recipients clicked a link to restore them.

stories.title: Pakistan Peoples Party to Organize Nationwide Rallies for Foundation Day
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Peoples Party has announced plans to conduct public gatherings across every district nationwide on November 30 to celebrate its Foundation Day. Party Chairman Bilawal Bhutto Zardari gave the directives for these events and will address the crowds live through a video link.

Local party branches throughout the country have received official instructions to begin preparations and organize the anniversary celebrations. The events aim to bring party members and supporters together under the leadership's guidance.

This nationwide mobilization highlights the party's ongoing efforts to engage its base across different districts. Further details regarding the specific venues and timings for the local gatherings will be managed by regional organizers in accordance with the central directives.

stories.title: Quad Leaders Expected to Convene in Manila for Regional Security Talks
stories.summary:
Leaders representing the United States, Japan, Australia, and India are anticipated to assemble on Tuesday on the margins of a major Asian gathering in Manila. According to two individuals knowledgeable about the preparations, this will mark the primary summit for the Quad alliance in two years.

The Indo-Pacific coalition functions largely as a counterbalance to the expanding footprint of China within the area, though participating nations maintain that the collective does not target any specific government. US Secretary of State Marco Rubio previously noted that the leaders might gather during the Association of Southeast Asian Nations summit, which kicks off on Sunday in the capital of the Philippines.

Talks are expected to focus on critical mineral supplies, as well as maintaining free and unrestricted commercial shipping lanes to safeguard global energy networks. An anonymous source indicated that the discussion will likely address recent security incidents involving attacks on commercial vessels.

The meeting underscores the ongoing diplomatic and strategic coordination among the four democratic powers in the Indo-Pacific. Authorities continue to finalize logistics for the Tuesday session as delegates arrive for the broader regional meetings.

stories.title: US Air Traffic Resumes Following Rare Nationwide Grounding and Severe Delays
stories.summary:
Flights across the United States began taking off again after a major four-hour nationwide ground stop caused by an outdated communications system failure. The emergency grounding on Friday created widespread travel chaos, affecting upwards of 20,000 flights and leaving hundreds of thousands of passengers stranded at airports nationwide.

Recovery efforts faced persistent obstacles on Saturday, with tracking data showing more than 3,900 cancellations and 2,500 delays as airlines scrambled to reposition aircraft and flight crews. Travelers reported exhaustion and frustration amid the lingering disruption, while US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy assured the public that commercial airspace remains safe despite the ongoing scheduling backlogs.

The disruption marked only the second time a nationwide ground stop has been ordered in the United States since the September 11 attacks, with the previous occurrence happening in January 2023. Federal aviation authorities lifted the restriction at 8:15 pm Eastern Time on Friday after restoring complete functionality to air traffic control systems.

Government officials attributed the failure to overloaded, decades-old equipment utilizing 1980s copper lines, prompting renewed calls from lawmakers for comprehensive investigations. Secretary Duffy appealed for a $50 billion investment to modernize the country's aging air traffic control infrastructure, while legislators emphasized the urgent need to address systemic vulnerabilities and prevent future nationwide outages.

stories.title: Pakistani President Reaffirms Strong Support for Palestine on Independence Anniversary
stories.summary:
President Asif Ali Zardari sent a congratulatory message to Palestinian President Mahmoud Abbas and the citizens of Palestine on the 38th anniversary of their Declaration of Independence. In his official letter, the Pakistani leader reiterated his nation's steadfast backing for the legitimate rights of Palestinians, specifically highlighting their fundamental right to self-determination.

Highlighting the deep ties between the two nations, the President noted that Pakistan and Palestine share close fraternal bonds anchored in a common history, mutual trust, and solidarity. He emphasized that the Pakistani population deeply respects Palestinians and remains dedicated to bolstering the friendship and brotherhood connecting both governments.

President Zardari re-stated Pakistan's principled position advocating for an independent, viable, and contiguous Palestinian state. This envisioned state would be established along pre-1967 borders with Al-Quds Al-Sharif serving as its capital, aligning with relevant United Nations resolutions.

Concluding his message, the President expressed enduring solidarity with the Palestinian population amidst their ongoing hardships. He conveyed strong support for their continuous pursuit of lasting peace, freedom, and human dignity.

stories.title: لطیف کھوسہ کی پرویز الٰہی سے ملاقات، سیاسی ڈیڈ لاک ختم کرنے پر زور
stories.summary:
پاکستان تحریک انصاف کے صدر پرویز الٰہی سے لطیف کھوسہ نے ملاقات کی ہے۔ اس ملاقات کے دوران لطیف کھوسہ نے پرویز الٰہی کو بانی پی ٹی آئی کے ساتھ ہونے والی اپنی حالیہ ملاقات کے بارے میں تفصیل سے آگاہ کیا۔

اس موقع پر گفتگو کرتے ہوئے پی ٹی آئی کے صدر پرویز الٰہی نے بانی پی ٹی آئی سے ہونے والی اس ملاقات کو ایک اچھا اور خوش آئند قدم قرار دیا۔ انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ موجودہ وقت میں خطے کے اندر بدلتے ہوئے حالات کا تقاضا ہے کہ ملک کے اندر بھی جاری سیاسی ڈیڈ لاک کا جلد از جلد خاتمہ کیا جائے۔

پرویز الٰہی نے مزید کہا کہ ملک میں اس وقت جو سیاسی ڈیڈ لاک چل رہا ہے وہ کسی بھی فریق کے مفاد میں نہیں ہے۔ ان کا خیال تھا کہ سیاسی بحران کو حل کرنے کے لیے رہنماؤں کی ملاقاتوں کا یہ سلسلہ آنے والے مستقبل میں بھی باقاعدگی کے ساتھ جاری رہنا چاہیے۔

اس ملاقات کے دوران سیاسی صورتحال کے علاوہ دیگر اہم قومی امور پر بھی تبادلہ خیال کیا گیا۔ اس ملاقات کا بنیادی مقصد ملکی سیاسی ماحول کو بہتر بنانا اور تمام فریقین کے درمیان رابطوں کو فروغ دینا ہے۔

stories.title: اقتصادی تعاون تنظیم کے وزرائے خارجہ کا دو روزہ اجلاس اسلام آباد میں شروع
stories.summary:
اقتصادی تعاون تنظیم کے وزرائے خارجہ کا دو روزہ اہم اجلاس آج سے اسلام آباد میں شروع ہو رہا ہے۔ اس دو روزہ کانفرنس میں مختلف اہم علاقائی اور معاشی امور پر تفصیلی گفتگو کی جائے گی۔

اجلاس کے حوالے سے تفصیلات کے مطابق ایران کے وزیر خارجہ عباس عراقچی اس تقریب میں خصوصی طور پر شرکت کرنے کے لیے تشریف لا رہے ہیں۔ تاہم واضح رہے کہ اس اجلاس میں افغان وزیر خارجہ کو شرکت کی کوئی دعوت نہیں دی گئی ہے۔

کانفرنس کے دوران بنیادی طور پر علاقائی تجارت کے فروغ دینے کے طریقوں، ٹرانسپورٹ کے شعبے میں تعاون بڑھانے اور توانائی کے وسائل پر تبادلہ خیال ہوگا۔ اس کے علاوہ وسطی ایشیا کے خطے کو عالمی منڈیوں کے ساتھ منسلک کرنے کے ممکنہ طریقوں پر بھی غور کیا جائے گا۔

یہ اجلاس اس خطے کے ممالک کے درمیان معاشی روابط کو مضبوط بنانے کی کوششوں کا ایک اہم حصہ ہے۔ تمام شریک ممالک ان شعبوں میں باہمی تعاون کو مزید وسعت دینے کے لیے لائحہ عمل تیار کریں گے۔

stories.title: امریکا اپنی ناکامیوں پر پردہ ڈالنے کے لیے جھوٹا بیانیہ بنا رہا ہے: اسماعیل بقائی
stories.summary:
ایرانی وزارت خارجہ کے ترجمان اسماعیل بقائی نے الزام عائد کیا ہے کہ امریکی انتظامیہ سیاسی اور فوجی محاذوں پر مشکلات کا شکار ہے اور ایران کے خلاف فوجی کارروائیوں کی ذمہ داری سے بچنے کے لیے حقائق کو مسخ کر رہی ہے۔

اسماعیل بقائی کا کہنا ہے کہ یہ دعویٰ بالکل بے بنیاد ہے کہ 1979 کے انقلاب کے بعد ایران نے امریکا کے ساتھ محاذ آرائی کی شروعات کی تھی۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ ایرانی انقلاب دراصل قومی خودمختاری، آزادی اور انسانی وقار کی بحالی کی ایک پرعزم جدوجہد کا نام تھا۔

ترجمان نے یاد دلایا کہ ایرانی عوام 1953 میں سی آئی اے کی حمایت سے ہونے والی بغاوت کو نہیں بھولے ہیں۔ واشنگٹن پر الزام عائد کیا گیا کہ اس نے دو مرتبہ مذاکرات کے دوران ایران پر بلااشتعال فوجی حملے کیے جن میں سپریم لیڈر سمیت اعلیٰ حکام کو نشانہ بنایا گیا، خواتین اور بچے شہید و زخمی ہوئے اور بنیادی ڈھانچے کو نقصان پہنچا۔

اسماعیل بقائی نے مزید کہا کہ واشنگٹن جنگ شروع کرنے کی ذمہ داری قبول کرنے سے گریزاں ہے اور اپنی کامیابیوں کا تاثر دے کر ناکامی چھپانے میں مصروف ہے۔ انہوں نے کہا کہ امریکی سیاسی نظام کی اعلیٰ ترین سطح پر بھی اس بات کا اعتراف کیا گیا ہے کہ ایران کے خلاف جنگ انتخابی شکست کی بڑی وجہ بنی۔

stories.title: اقتصادی تعاون تنظیم (ای سی او) کے وزرائے خارجہ کا دو روزہ اجلاس اسلام آباد میں شروع
stories.summary:
اسلام آباد میں اقتصادی تعاون تنظیم (ای سی او) کونسل آف منسٹرز کا دو روزہ اجلاس آج شروع ہو رہا ہے۔ اجلاس میں علاقائی تجارت، توانائی، ٹرانسپورٹ اور وسطی ایشیا کو عالمی منڈیوں سے مربوط کرنے کے لیے مشترکہ حکمت عملی پر غور کیا جائے گا۔

اس اہم اجلاس میں شرکت کے لیے رکن ممالک کے وزرائے خارجہ اور اعلیٰ سطح کے وفود کی پاکستان آمد کا سلسلہ جاری ہے۔ ایرانی وزیر عباس عراقچی خصوصی طور پر اجلاس میں شرکت کے لیے پہنچ رہے ہیں جبکہ ترک جمہوریہ شمالی قبرص کے وزیر خارجہ تحسین ارطغرل اوغلو بھی اسلام آباد آ چکے ہیں۔ اجلاس میں تاجکستان اور ایران سمیت دیگر ممالک کے وزرائے خارجہ شریک ہوں گے، جبکہ کرغزستان، قازقستان اور ترکیے کی نمائندگی نائب وزرائے خارجہ کریں گے۔ افغان وزیر خارجہ کو اجلاس میں شرکت کی دعوت نہیں دی گئی ہے۔

نائب وزیراعظم و وزیر اور خارجہ اسحاق ڈار اجلاس کی افتتاحی تقریب سے خطاب کریں گے۔ اس کے علاوہ ای سی او کے سیکریٹری جنرل اسد مجید خان اور رکن ممالک کے وزرائے خارجہ بھی اپنے خیالات کا اظہار کریں گے۔

اجلاس کے دوران رکن ممالک میں اقتصادی و تجارتی روابط کے فروغ اور بنیادی ڈھانچے کو بہتر بنانے پر بات ہوگی۔ غیر ملکی وزرائے خارجہ کی وزیراعظم شہباز شریف سے ملاقات اور ان کے اعزاز میں ظہرانے کا بھی اہتمام کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: پنجاب میں گنے کا کسان سیزن آج سے باضابطہ طور پر شروع ہوگا
stories.summary:
پنجاب حکومت کی جانب سے باضابطہ نوٹیفکیشن جاری کیے جانے کے بعد صوبے بھر میں گنے کا کرشنگ سیزن آج 15 نومبر سے شروع ہو رہا ہے۔ یہ نوٹیفکیشن محکمہ فوڈ سیکیورٹی اینڈ کنزیومر پروٹیکشن کی طرف سے جاری کیا گیا ہے۔

جاری کردہ نوٹیفکیشن کی رو سے پنجاب بھر میں موجود تمام شوگر ملیں پابند ہوں گی کہ وہ کسانوں سے گنے کی خریداری کریں۔ ذرائع کے مطابق تمام شوگر ملیں گنے کی خریداری کا ریٹ مارکیٹ فورسز کے طے کردہ میکزم کے مطابق ہی جاری کریں گی۔

موجودہ سیزن کے حوالے سے اعداد و شمار بتاتے ہیں کہ پنجاب میں اس سال کل 47 میں سے 41 شوگر ملیں فعال حالت میں ہیں۔ اس سال صوبے کے اندر مجموعی طور پر 24 لاکھ 52 ہزار ایکڑ کے وسیع رقبے پر گنے کی فصل کاشت کی گئی ہے۔

محکمہ ذرائع کا کہنا ہے کہ رواں سال گنے کی یہ کاشت گزشتہ سال کے مقابلے میں 16 فیصد زیادہ ریکارڈ کی گئی ہے۔ کرشنگ سیزن کے آغاز سے چینی کی پیداوار اور کسانوں کے معاملات پر براہ راست اثر پڑے گا۔

stories.title: لاہور میں ڈیوس روڈ پر ٹریفک حادثے کے نتیجے میں دو سگے بھائی جاں بحق
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے ڈیوس روڈ پر ایک دلخراش ٹریفک حادثے میں موٹر سائیکل پر سوار دو سگے بھائی موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گئے۔

پولیس کے مطابق یہ حادثہ تیز رفتار موٹر سائیکل کے فٹ پاتھ سے ٹکرانے کے باعث پیش آیا۔ حادثے میں جاں بحق ہونے والے دونوں نوجوانوں کی شناخت ساجد اور کلیم کے ناموں سے ہوئی ہے۔

حادثے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی پولیس فوری طور پر موقع پر پہنچ گئی۔ پولیس نے دونوں بھائیوں کی لاشوں کو اپنی تحویل میں لے کر ضروری قانونی کارروائی کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔

اس افسوسناک حادثے کے بعد پولیس کی جانب سے مزید تفصیلات اور شواہد اکٹھے کیے جا رہے ہیں تاکہ حادثے کی اصل وجوہات کا تعین کیا جا سکے۔

stories.title: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Misled Executives Over Chinese Businesswoman Affair
stories.summary:
Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang misled top company leaders, including general counsel Tim Teter and chief marketing officer Alison Wagonfeld, regarding his affair with Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang, according to internal correspondence and sources familiar with the matter. Reuters reviewed electronic exchanges from October, marking the first time this correspondence has been reported. 

In the wake of the scandal, Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on Thursday, stepping down from his prominent role leading a pioneer in artificial intelligence technology. He issued a statement on Sunday apologizing for being unfaithful to his wife and disappointing the company, though he did not explicitly name Alice Huang. Alice Huang is a former executive of Megaspeed International, an Nvidia customer that faced US investigations regarding potential spying for China. Both individuals share a surname but are not related. 

During autumn 2025 and October 2026, when press inquiries linked Huang to Megaspeed and Alice Huang, he assured Nvidia leaders that his interactions were appropriate and constituted standard business dealings with customers. Messages also showed discussions regarding potential legal action against The New York Times following an October report that highlighted public meetings between Huang and Alice Huang, though no lawsuit was filed. Verification by Reuters indicates that photographs of the pair together date back as far as December 2023 across the US, China, and other locations. 

Independent members of Nvidia's board announced on November 10 that they hired the Wall Street law firm Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz to conduct an independent investigation. This followed reports of the relationship and US authorities' suspicions regarding potential Chinese espionage, an accusation denied by Beijing. Meanwhile, Nvidia's stock has declined by more than 30% from its October 6 closing high, erasing over $1.8 trillion in market capitalization.

stories.title: Thousands of Protesters Rally in Antalya Demanding Climate Action at COP31
stories.summary:
Thousands of demonstrators marched through the rainy streets of Antalya on Saturday to protest against the 31st United Nations Climate Change Conference (COP31), accusing global climate summits of failing populations most vulnerable to environmental destruction. The protest coincided with the midpoint of the two-week conference, where negotiators from nearly 200 nations are attempting to forge a final agreement by Friday. Activists expressed widespread frustration that the summit is unlikely to yield major breakthroughs or sufficient pledges to phase out fossil fuels and aid poorer nations.

Organized by environmental groups, trade unions, and rights organizations, the demonstration drew an estimated 7,000 participants under strict police monitoring. Protesters, including some waving LGBT rainbow flags, traveled from various regions to voice opposition to what they termed a disguised conference sponsored by corporate monopolies. Demonstrators criticized co-host Turkey for lacking a concrete roadmap to eliminate fossil fuels and continuing to open new coal mines and power stations. 

Inside the summit, negotiators remained deeply divided on critical topics such as financing adaptation for developing nations, defending climate science, and transitioning away from fossil energy toward renewables. Australian climate minister Chris Bowen, who chairs the formal negotiations, reported positive conversations despite the difficult time constraints. UN climate chief Simon Stiell emphasized that addressing the crisis requires steady, progressive action rather than a single quick fix.

During high-level dialogues at the summit, officials like Pakistan's Parliamentary Secretary for Information and Broadcasting, Barrister Danyal Chaudhry, stressed the economic realities of climate inaction for debt-stressed nations. Chaudhry presented five parliamentary recommendations, calling for climate-proofed fiscal policies, protected renewable transitions, viewing adaptation as an investment rather than an expense, reforming global debt structures through swaps and concessional financing, and enhancing parliamentary oversight of climate funds.

stories.title: Italy Fines Meta $887 Million Over Unauthorized Access to Android Data
stories.summary:
Italy's data protection agency announced on Saturday that it has issued a fine of €805 million, equivalent to $887 million, against Meta Platforms. The penalty was levied after the regulatory body discovered that the company accessed Android users' personal photographs and videos without securing proper consent or providing adequate notification.

The investigation revealed that Meta gained access to these media files through a Facebook application feature designed to suggest content from users' personal galleries for potential posting. The Italian privacy authority ordered Meta to disable this feature by default within 60 days and require explicit, separate user consent before it can operate.

A spokesperson for Meta strongly disagreed with the decision, calling the fine disproportionate and confirming plans to appeal. The company defended the functionality as a simple tool helping users share photos and videos on Facebook, noting that device-level permissions must be granted by users and can be modified in settings at any time. 

Initiated in 2025, the investigation did not examine whether the collected content was utilized to train artificial intelligence models, a practice denied by Meta. However, the authority noted it retains the right to separately evaluate a newer cloud-processing feature launched in 2026. The financial penalty amounts to approximately 0.47% of Meta's global revenue and impacts roughly 20 million Android users across Italy.

stories.title: کراچی میں واٹر پمپ پل پر ٹرک کے بریک فیل، پانچ گاڑیاں متاثر، ڈرائیور فرار
stories.summary:
کراچی میں واٹر پمپ پل سے اترتے ہوئے ایک ٹرک کے بریک مبینہ طور پر فیل ہو گئے، جس کے نتیجے میں بے قابو ہو کر ٹرک نے پانچ گاڑیوں کو ٹکر مار دی۔

اس حادثے کی وجہ سے واٹر پمپ کی جانب جانے والی پانچوں گاڑیوں کو شدید نقصان پہنچا۔ خوش قسمتی سے تمام گاڑیوں میں سوار افراد محفوظ رہے اور اس حادثے میں کوئی جانی نقصان نہیں ہوا۔ تاہم حادثے کے بعد ٹرک ڈرائیور موقع سے فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گیا۔

واقعے کے بعد مشتعل شہریوں نے ٹرک کے کلینر شاہ پیر کو پکڑ کر تشدد کا نشانہ بنایا۔ اطلاع ملنے پر پولیس فوری طور پر موقع پر پہنچی اور ٹرک سمیت کلینر کو اپنی تحویل میں لے کر تھانے منتقل کر دیا۔

پولیس کے مطابق ٹرک کے مالک نے حادثے سے متاثر ہونے والے شہریوں کی گاڑیوں کے نقصانات کا ازالہ کرنے کی ذمہ داری قبول کر لی ہے۔ پولیس فرار ہونے والے ڈرائیور کی تلاش کے لیے تفصیلات جمع کر رہی ہے۔

stories.title: کراچی کے علاقے یاسین آباد میں فائرنگ سے حیدرآباد کا شہری جاں بحق
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے گلشن اقبال یاسین آباد ندی کے قریب پیش آنے والے فائرنگ کے واقعے میں حیدرآباد کے لطیف آباد نمبر 8 کے رہائشی اڑتیس سالہ فرقان ولد ظفر جاں بحق ہو گئے۔ مقتول چار بچوں کا باپ اور اسکول یونیفارم کا کاروبار کرتا تھا جو کاروباری سلسلے میں اکثر کراچی آتا رہتا تھا۔

واقعے کے وقت مقتول اپنے دوستوں آصف اور وقاص کے ہمراہ گاڑی میں سوار ہو کر عائشہ منزل کی جانب جا رہا تھا کہ نامعلوم ملزمان کی مبینہ فائرنگ سے چہرے پر آنکھ کے نیچے گولی لگنے سے زخمی ہو گیا۔ اسے فوری طور پر سندھ گورنمنٹ اسپتال لیاقت آباد منتقل کیا گیا جہاں ڈاکٹروں نے اس کی موت کی تصدیق کر دی۔

پولیس نے واقعے کو مشکوک قرار دیتے ہوئے مقتول کی گاڑی میں موجود دونوں دوستوں سے پوچھ گچھ شروع کر دی ہے۔ حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ مقتول کے دوستوں کی جانب سے بتائے گئے جائے وقوعہ سے نہ تو کوئی گولی کا خول ملا ہے اور نہ ہی خون کے نشانات برآمد ہوئے ہیں۔

ابتدائی اطلاعات میں اس واقعے کو ڈکیتی مزاحمت کا نتیجہ قرار دیا گیا تھا تاہم رات گئے تک گلشن اقبال اور جوہرآباد پولیس کے درمیان جائے وقوعہ کی حدود کا تعین بھی نہ ہو سکا اور دونوں تھانوں کے ایس ایچ اوز واقعہ ایک دوسرے کی حدود میں ہونے کا مؤقف پیش کرتے رہے۔ پولیس کی جانب سے معاملے کی مزید تحقیقات جاری ہیں۔

stories.title: Opposition leaders challenge detention of KP Chief Minister and lawmakers
stories.summary:
National Assembly Opposition Leader Mehmood Khan Achakzai and Senate Opposition Leader Raja Nasir Abbas filed a joint petition at the Federal Constitutional Court on Saturday to demand the immediate release of suspended Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Chief Minister Sohail Afridi and eight other parliamentarians. These PTI-backed lawmakers were placed in preventive custody shortly before the federal government declared governor's rule and an emergency in the province on October 11.

The petitioners argued that holding elected representatives undermines the public mandate and violates several articles of the Constitution, specifically Articles 4, 14, 17, and 25, which protect fundamental rights. Furthermore, the petition stated that extraordinary powers and governor's rule do not suspend these constitutional rights, meaning all government actions remain subject to judicial review. The legal filing asks the court to inspect the legal justification for the detentions, disclose the whereabouts and legal status of the detainees, and order their release.

According to the petition, incarcerated PTI founder Imran Khan instructed Achakzai and Nasir Abbas to initiate dialogue with the government. The opposition leaders emphasized that state machinery should not be utilized to suppress political opposition or neutralize elected officials.

In related remarks, Raja Nasir Abbas spoke to Geo News regarding a separate legal effort in Peshawar to ascertain the whereabouts of Sohail Afridi and provincial assembly speaker Babar Saleem Swati. Abbas stressed that political dialogue and constitutional adherence represent the only viable path forward to resolve the country's ongoing political and administrative difficulties.

stories.title: میئر کراچی مرتضیٰ وہاب نے ترقیاتی اسکیموں میں ردوبدل پر پابندی عائد کر دی
stories.summary:
میئر کراچی بیرسٹر مرتضیٰ وہاب نے بلدیہ عظمیٰ کراچی میں جاری ترقیاتی اسکیموں میں ردوبدل پر مکمل پابندی عائد کرتے ہوئے متعلقہ افسران کو تمام منصوبے بروقت مکمل کرنے کی ہدایت کی ہے۔ انہوں نے سست روی اور غیر معیاری تعمیراتی سامان کے استعمال کی شکایات پر سخت کارروائی کا حکم بھی دیا۔

یہ احکامات کے ایم سی ہیڈ آفس میں محکمہ انجینئرنگ کے اجلاس کے دوران جاری کیے گئے جس میں چھبیس اہم شاہراہوں اور ایک سڑکیہ نیٹ ورک کی ترقیاتی اسکیموں کا جائزہ لیا گیا۔ اجلاس میں میونسپل کمشنر ابرار جعفر، فنانس ایڈوائزر گلزار ابڑو، ڈائریکٹر میڈیا دانیال سیال اور ڈی جی ٹیکنیکل سروسز طارق مغل سمیت دیگر سینئر افسران شریک ہوئے۔

میئر کراچی نے شہریوں کی شکایات پر سخت نوٹس لیتے ہوئے میونسپل کمشنر کو سات روز کے اندر ٹھیکیداروں کے خلاف شکایات کی جامع تحقیقات کر کے رپورٹ پیش کرنے کی ہدایت کی۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ ترقیاتی کام منظور شدہ شیڈول اور معیار کے مطابق ہونے چاہئیں اور عوام کے ٹیکس کا پیسہ ذمہ داری سے خرچ کیا جائے۔

انتظامی رکاوٹیں دور کرنے کی ہدایت کرتے ہوئے انہوں نے جاری ترقیاتی اسکیموں کے لیے پندرہ روز کی ڈیڈ لائن مقرر کی اور دسمبر کے اختتام تک تمام کام مکمل کرنے کا عزم ظاہر کیا۔ انہوں نے ہدایت کی کہ اضافی کام کے لیے جاری اسکیم بدلنے کے بجائے علیحدہ اسکیم تیار کی جائے۔

stories.title: Technical Malfunction Disrupts US Transportation Secretary Press Conference on Flight Chaos
stories.summary:
Trump administration officials faced an awkward situation on Saturday in Washington, DC, when a live televised press conference addressing a massive nationwide tech disruption of US flights was itself interrupted by technical problems. US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy took the podium at the Department of Transportation headquarters to discuss a disastrous nationwide ground stop that had grounded thousands of flights due to ageing technology.

As Duffy began speaking, a deep, echoing hum emerged from the microphones and speakers. Pausing on camera, Duffy said into the mic, "Check one two, three four, five six seven?" and stepped away, apologizing for the issue while technicians scrambled to replace microphones and adjust cables. Although Duffy resumed his remarks shortly after, brittle feedback hit the room seconds later, leaving him visibly irritated as he realized the poor symbolism of an on-camera equipment failure following a major aviation shutdown.

The three-minute pause was broadcast live across US television networks. Duffy was joined at the briefing by Federal Aviation Administration head Bryan Bedford and, ironically, the FAA's chief technology officer, Rebecca Guy, who was participating in her first press conference alongside the secretary. Throughout the briefing, Duffy and Bedford emphasized the ongoing systemic difficulties involved in transitioning from outdated 1970s and 1980s air traffic control equipment to modern technology.

stories.title: نئے انتظامی یونٹس کے قیام کا فارمولا آخری مرحلے میں داخل، فاروق ستار
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے سینئر مرکزی رہنما ڈاکٹر فاروق ستار نے گلشنِ اقبال بلاک 10 میں ریحان سوسائٹی کے تحت منعقدہ نشست سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ ملک کی ترقی اور بقا نئے انتظامی یونٹس کے قیام سے جڑی ہوئی ہے۔ اس تقریب میں سابق میئر کراچی وسیم اختر، خالد سلطان اور علاقہ معززین کی بڑی تعداد نے شرکت کی۔

ڈاکٹر فاروق ستار نے معاشی صورتحال کا ذکر کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ ویتنام کی برآمدات چار سو ارب ڈالر تک پہنچ چکی ہیں جبکہ پاکستان اب بھی تیس ارب ڈالر برآمدات اور اتنی ہی ترسیلاتِ زر کے ساتھ قرضوں میں جکڑا ہوا ہے۔ انہوں نے الزام عائد کیا کہ صوبائی حکومت نے ماضی میں کراچی کو ایک قطرہ نیا پانی نہیں دیا اور کے فور منصوبہ ادھورا پڑا ہے۔

انہوں نے کہا کہ ملک کی ترقی کے لیے اضلاع اور ڈویژنز کو انتظامی بنیادوں پر خود مختار بنانا ہوگا اور اسلام آباد کی اس تجویز کی عوامی ریفرنڈم کے ذریعے بھرپور حمایت کی جانی چاہیے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ نئے انتظامی یونٹس بننے سے کراچی سمیت لاڑکانہ، دادو، نوابشاہ، سکھر اور حیدرآباد سمیت سندھ کے ہر ضلع کے باسیوں کو یکساں حقوق ملیں گے۔

انہوں نے خوشخبری سنائی کہ نئے انتظامی یونٹس کے قیام کا فارمولا اپنے آخری مرحلے میں داخل ہو چکا ہے اور آئندہ سال مارچ تک نئے انتظامی یونٹس وجود میں آ سکتے ہیں۔ انہوں نے زور دیا کہ اس نظام کو عوامی بیداری اور ریفرنڈم کے ذریعے ہر صورت نافذ کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: Punjab Government Approves Transfer of Gulfstream G500 Operations to Pakistan Air Force
stories.summary:
The Punjab government has formally approved a proposal to transition the operational control and maintenance of its Gulfstream G500 aircraft to the Pakistan Air Force (PAF). According to official documents, the provincial administration has cleared a draft Memorandum of Understanding with the PAF that outlines technical matters, financial arrangements, and aircraft maintenance protocols.

To facilitate the transition, the aircraft has already been de-registered with the Pakistan Civil Aviation Authority. Additionally, the services of three active-duty PAF pilots have been placed at the disposal of the provincial government on deputation. These pilots will manage flight operations alongside the pilots already employed by the Punjab government.

The decision follows consultations between the Punjab government's VIP Flight Wing and the PAF, which possesses the necessary infrastructure and trained personnel to maintain the aircraft properly. Discussions focused on ensuring round-the-clock availability, continuous operational readiness, and safe flights for the Gulfstream G500. The Additional Secretary for Welfare and the Services and General Administration Department has been authorized to officially sign the agreement on behalf of the provincial government.

stories.title: Pakistan Railways Reaches Historic Revenue Milestone of One Hundred Billion Rupees
stories.summary:
Pakistan Railways has crossed a historic financial threshold by generating more than one hundred billion rupees in revenue for the first time in its history. Federal Minister for Railways Muhammad Hanif Abbasi announced the milestone during a meeting in Islamabad with Minister for Parliamentary Affairs Tariq Fazal Chaudhry while briefing him on the department's performance.

During their discussions, Abbasi reaffirmed the railway department's commitment to reaching an ambitious revenue target of one hundred and sixty billion rupees for the current financial year. Previously, the railway minister also expressed optimism about achieving a revenue of 1 trillion during the 2026-27 financial year. To help meet growing demands from the business community and further boost income, Pakistan Railways plans to increase its operational freight trains to 14 by January 2027.

This strategy follows decisions made during a meeting chaired by Abbasi at the Railways Headquarters, which also approved the creation of a dry port in Khanewal. The new facility is intended to strengthen overall freight operations and generate additional revenue streams for the national railway network.

stories.title: کراچی: گڈاپ سٹی تھانے سے ملزم فرار، تین پولیس اہلکار معطل
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے گڈاپ سٹی تھانے سے ایک زیر حراست ملزم مبینہ طور پر فرار ہو گیا ہے۔ پولیس تحویل سے ملزم کے نکل جانے کے واقعے پر فوری نوٹس لیتے ہوئے غفلت اور لاپرواہی کا مظاہرہ کرنے والے تینوں پولیس اہلکاروں کو کوارٹر گارڈ کر دیا گیا ہے۔ حکام کی جانب سے اس معاملے کی باقاعدہ تحقیقات کا حکم بھی جاری کر دیا گیا ہے۔

ابتدائی اطلاعات میں اس زیر حراست شخص کو گڈاپ سٹی میں پیش آنے والی آٹھ کروڑ روپے کی ڈکیتی کی واردات کا ملزم قرار دیا جا رہا تھا۔ تاہم، ایس ایس پی ملیر ڈاکٹر عبدالخالق پیرزادہ نے واضح کیا ہے کہ فرار ہونے والے ملزم کا اس آٹھ کروڑ روپے کی ڈکیتی کے واقعے سے کوئی تعلق نہیں ہے۔

اس حوالے سے تاجر کشن چند کا ایک ویڈیو بیان بھی سامنے آ چکا ہے، جس میں انہوں نے تصدیق کی ہے کہ فرار ہونے والا شخص ان کے گھر پر ہونے والی واردات میں ملوث نہیں تھا۔ اصل میں اس ملزم کو چوری کے شبے میں حراست میں لیا گیا تھا جو بعد ازاں پولیس کی گرفت سے نکلنے میں کامیاب ہو گیا۔

متعلقہ حکام کے مطابق فرار ہونے والے ملزم کا تعلق موٹر سائیکل گینگ سے تھا۔ پولیس نے اس کی تلاش کے لیے کارروائیاں شروع کر دی ہیں جبکہ ڈیوٹی پر غفلت برتنے والے تمام ذمہ دار اہلکاروں کے خلاف محکمہ جاتی کارروائی بھی عمل میں لائی جا رہی ہے۔

stories.title: Trump Administration Proposes New Rules to Cut Food Stamps for Millions
stories.summary:
The Trump administration moved on Tuesday to remove millions of Americans from the country's primary food assistance program, even as enrollment continues to decline following previous administration cuts. A newly proposed rule issued by the US Department of Agriculture aims to eliminate automatic eligibility for Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program benefits—commonly known as food stamps—for households receiving cash aid through the Temporary Assistance for Needy Families program.

Under current guidelines, households receiving TANF qualify for SNAP without needing to meet federal income thresholds, though TANF eligibility standards vary by state between 130% and 200% of the federal poverty level, while standard SNAP eligibility is capped at 130%. According to a USDA analysis included in the proposal, the regulatory change would strip benefits from roughly 6.3 million people, representing nearly 18% of all SNAP recipients. The agency stated that the adjustments would standardize eligibility and preserve assistance for the truly needy.

More than 5.5 million people have already lost food stamp benefits since President Donald Trump implemented program cuts in his July 2025 tax law, reducing total enrollment to approximately 36 million. The USDA also estimates that 1.8 million children would lose eligibility for free school lunches because SNAP enrollment automatically confers access to other food aid programs. Democratic Representative Angie Craig of Minnesota criticized the proposal as heartless and cruel, while the public has been given a 30-day window to submit comments on the new rule.

stories.title: کراچی کے علاقے گڈاپ میں تاجر کے گھر ڈکیتی کے ملزمان پولیس حراست سے فرار
stories.summary:
کراچی کے علاقے گڈاپ میں چند ماہ قبل ایک تاجر کے گھر ہونے والی بڑی ڈکیتی میں ملوث تین ملزمان گڈاپ پولیس کی حراست سے فرار ہو گئے۔ پولیس ذرائع کے مطابق اس ڈکیتی میں ایک سنار سمیت تین ملزمان ملوث تھے جن میں سے دو ڈاکو پولیس اہلکاروں کو چکمہ دے کر فرار ہونے میں کامیاب ہو گئے اور جاتے ہوئے ایک پولیس اہلکار کی موٹر سائیکل بھی اپنے ساتھ لے گئے۔ ایس ایس پی ملیر نے اس واقعے کا نوٹس لیتے ہوئے کہا ہے کہ اس معاملے کے بارے میں معلوم ہو گیا ہے اور جس پولیس افسر یا اہلکار کی غفلت سے یہ واقعہ پیش آیا ہے اس کے خلاف سخت کارروائی کی جائے گی۔

پولیس کے مطابق یہ ڈکیتی کا واقعہ چار ماہ قبل گڈاپ میں ایک تاجر کے گھر پیش آیا تھا جہاں نو کروڑ روپے مالیت کی واردات کی گئی تھی۔ ڈاکو اس گھر سے دو سو تولہ سونا، چاندی اور پچیس لاکھ روپے نقدی لے کر فرار ہوئے تھے، اور اس واردات کا مقدمہ گڈاپ تھانے میں درج کیا گیا تھا۔ اس سلسلے میں مزید تفتیش جاری ہے تاکہ فرار ہونے والے ملزمان کا سراغ لگایا جا سکے اور انہیں دوبارہ گرفتار کیا جا سکے۔

اس نوعیت کے واقعات قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کی کارکردگی پر بڑے سوالیہ نشان اٹھاتے ہیں، خاص طور پر جب سنگین جرائم میں ملوث ملزمان پولیس کی حراست سے فرار ہو جائیں۔ اعلیٰ پولیس حکام کی جانب سے غفلت برتنے والے اہلکاروں کے خلاف کارروائی کے اعلان سے امید کی جا رہی ہے کہ ذمہ داروں کو کیفر کردار تک پہنچایا جائے گا تاکہ مستقبل میں اس قسم کی لاپرواہیوں سے بچا جا سکے اور شہریوں کے جان و مال کے تحفظ کو یقینی بنایا جا سکے جو کہ پولیس کی اولین ذمہ داری ہے۔

stories.title: Abdul Samad goal secures Pakistan historic SAFF Championship final spot
stories.summary:
Pakistan advanced to their first-ever SAFF Championship final following a dramatic 1-0 victory over hosts Bangladesh at the National Stadium in Dhaka on Saturday. Denmark-based forward Abdul Samad Arshad scored the decisive goal in the closing stages of the match, unleashing a powerful left-footed drive past goalkeeper Mehedi Hasan Srabon after skilfully creating space on the right side. The dramatic strike silenced the home crowd and broke a long history of semi-final disappointments for the Shaheens, who had previously reached the last four on four occasions without progressing.

Coached by Nolberto Solano, Pakistan entered the semi-finals as Group 'B' runners-up after opening their campaign with a 3-2 defeat against India before recovering with a 3-0 win over the Maldives. During Saturday's semi-final, Bangladesh commanded roughly 62 to 64 percent of possession and utilised their home advantage to press for an opener. Despite facing sustained pressure, Pakistan maintained a disciplined and well-organised defence while remaining a threat on counter-attacks, ultimately registering more shots and efforts on target than the hosts.

The encounter saw brief interruptions, including a flare thrown onto the pitch by frustrated local supporters as Bangladesh pushed for a late equaliser. The arrival of overseas-based players like Samad provided a timely boost for the squad during the knockout rounds, as earlier group-stage fixtures occurred outside the official FIFA international window. With this victory, Solano's team moves one step closer to claiming their first regional title.

Pakistan will now face their arch-rivals and defending champions, India, in the final on Tuesday. India secured their spot in the championship match by defeating Bhutan 2-1 in the other semi-final. Solano and his players will aim to cap their historic tournament run by overcoming India to lift the trophy.

stories.title: PAF chief meets Uzbek defence leaders to strengthen military cooperation
stories.summary:
Chief of the Air Staff Air Chief Marshal Zaheer Ahmed Baber Sidhu met with senior defence leadership in Uzbekistan during an official visit to discuss regional security and deepen bilateral defence ties. According to an Inter-Services Public Relations statement issued on Saturday, the air chief held discussions with Uzbek Defence Minister Lieutenant General Botir Qudrathodjayev Bahromovich regarding existing military cooperation and institutional collaboration.

During their meeting, the Uzbek defence minister commended the professional standards, operational capabilities, and combat effectiveness demonstrated by the Pakistan Air Force. The discussions highlighted the longstanding fraternal relations shared between Pakistan and Uzbekistan. Both nations expressed a mutual dedication to boosting operational readiness and building partnerships in emerging technologies.

Air Chief Marshal Sidhu also held talks with Major General Burkhanov Akhmad Jamolovich, who serves as Uzbekistan's Deputy Defence Minister and Commander of the Air Defence and Air Force. Those talks centered on expanding bilateral ties through joint military exercises, structured professional exchanges, and targeted capacity-building initiatives by leveraging the unique expertise of both armed forces.

The high-level visit underscores ongoing efforts by both countries to enhance bilateral defence cooperation and address regional security concerns together. By exploring joint training and technological collaboration, the two air forces aim to solidify their strategic partnership and mutual defence capabilities.

stories.title: Sophie Cunningham reports receiving thousands of angry gambling direct messages
stories.summary:
Indiana Fever guard Sophie Cunningham revealed that she has been subjected to thousands of angry direct messages on social media from sports bettors blaming her for lost wagers. Speaking on the podcast 'No Hesitation', which she co-hosts with basketball trainer Drew Hanlen, Cunningham stated that she could easily show thousands of messages from individuals upset because she did not perform a specific way and cost them money. She questioned why fans chose to bet on her statistics rather than star teammates like Aliyah Boston, Caitlin Clark, or Kelsey Mitchell, noting she rarely knows how many three-point shots she will take during a game.

Cunningham explained that the integration of gambling into basketball has made fans significantly more vocal when players fail to meet expectations. She avoids using the platform X, describing it as extremely toxic, and chooses instead to focus on receiving encouraging messages. Hanlen echoed her sentiments during the episode, voicing frustration that social media users frequently hide behind anonymous troll accounts instead of using their real names.

The discussion follows a push by professional sports leagues regarding harassment related to sports betting. In September, organisations including the NFL, NBA, MLB, NHL, and MLS, along with player unions, sent letters to gambling regulators in 35 states and the District of Columbia. They requested lifetime betting bans for anyone threatening athletes, coaches, or officials, alongside simplified reporting channels. A follow-up letter submitted on September 24 by the NBA, WNBA, and associated unions reiterated similar concerns about escalating betting-related harassment from gamblers on the losing side of wagers.

stories.title: Refugee camps, an RSS cell plot, and Dawn under attack in 1947
stories.summary:
Historical archives from September 1947 highlight key events during Pakistan's turbulent early days, including refugee struggles, the uncovering of a militant cell, and attacks on the media. Amid waves of migration marked by severe violence and communal conflict across partitioned regions, founder Mohammad Ali Jinnah and his sister Fatima Jinnah visited multiple refugee camps and a transit centre. The governor-general listened to harrowing accounts of devastation from displaced citizens, including a former jagirdar from Alwar State, and urged the suffering masses to maintain hope while assuring them of state support.

During the same period, political developments unfolded regarding Baluchistan, where local leaders advocated for full provincial status and representative governance. Qazi Mohammad Isa, president of the Baluchistan Provincial Muslim League, met with Jinnah and Prime Minister Liaquat Ali Khan in Karachi to convey the populace's strong desire to remain within Pakistan and establish a government responsible to its people, separate from discussions surrounding Kalat State.

Simultaneously, security forces in Karachi dismantled an underground network belonging to the Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh following a chance bomb explosion in Shikarpuri Colony on September 10. House-to-house searches yielded documents and explosives, leading to the arrest of thirty terrorist leaders involved in disruptive plots. The group's activities underscored the severe security challenges faced by the newly formed dominion during the partition era.

The period also witnessed severe hostility directed at the press, notably a two-hour military battle defending the Dawn press in Delhi on September 14. As the primary voice of the Muslim League and subcontinent Muslims, the newspaper faced intense violence from opponents of Pakistan, leaving staff cut off and navigating constant danger. Examining these historical archives offers perspective on recurring political, security, and media struggles that continue to shape the nation.

stories.title: Elon Musk Warns Nvidia Faces Crisis and Lost Deals Without Jensen Huang
stories.summary:
Billionaire Elon Musk stated on Saturday that chipmaker Nvidia risks losing critical business agreements following the departure of its chief executive officer, Jensen Huang. Huang stepped down on Thursday after disclosures regarding extramarital affairs, including a relationship with Alice Huang, a former executive of Singapore-based Megaspeed who faced investigations by United States authorities. The situation has thrown the four trillion-dollar company into a crisis and threatened the artificial intelligence sector that Huang heavily supported by reinvesting funds into cloud providers, suppliers, and major labs.

Writing on X, Musk praised Huang for efficiently managing the supply chain, noting that many crucial arrangements relied on a personal handshake with the former CEO rather than formal written contracts. Musk expressed doubt that these agreements would survive without him and mentioned that a petition was circulating to reinstate Huang, which he intended to sign. Nvidia declined to comment on the matter, and Reuters could not independently verify the claims.

Following the scandal, Nvidia's board is investigating whether Huang was the target of foreign intelligence efforts. Meanwhile, CNN reported that US intelligence agencies are still examining the nature of Alice Huang's ties to the Chinese government, though current collected information does not definitively prove she acted as a spy for Beijing. Nvidia's finance chief, Colette Kress, has stepped in as interim CEO while the board evaluates potential successors.

Among the names discussed by analysts to succeed Huang are Arm Holdings CEO Rene Haas, who previously worked at Nvidia, and other industry leaders such as AMD chief Lisa Su, Micron chief Sanjay Mehrotra, Marvell head Matt Murphy, Apple hardware chief Johny Srouji, and former Apple chief Tim Cook, who was floated by US President Donald Trump. The leadership transition comes as the company navigates increasing regulatory scrutiny and potential restrictions on chip exports to China.

stories.title: US Supreme Court Agrees to Review Trump Asylum Restrictions
stories.summary:
The United States Supreme Court announced on Friday that it will review the legality of President Donald Trump’s restrictions on asylum seekers at the US-Mexico border. The administration credits the hardline immigration policy with decreasing unauthorized border crossings. The justices agreed to hear an appeal from the Trump administration after a lower court ruled that the president exceeded his authority by prohibiting migrants who entered the country illegally from applying for asylum.

President Trump introduced the new asylum limits on January 20, 2025, just hours into his second term, describing the migrant influx as an invasion. The policy extends beyond measures implemented by his predecessor, Joe Biden. Under the current rules, migrants crossing the southern border without authorization are barred from seeking asylum. The prohibition also impacts individuals arriving at official ports of entry who lack specific medical or criminal history details, criteria that advocates argue are often impossible to fulfill for people fleeing violence.

Immigrant rights groups previously filed a class-action lawsuit against the policy on behalf of prospective asylum seekers who reported being denied credible fear interviews to assess potential persecution based on race, religion, nationality, political opinion, or membership in a social group. A federal judge in Washington, DC ruled in favor of the plaintiffs in July 2025, and the US Court of Appeals for the District of Columbia Circuit upheld that decision in April while temporarily blocking it to allow for the administration's appeal.

The Supreme Court, which holds a 6-3 conservative majority, is scheduled to hear arguments in the upcoming months and deliver a ruling by the end of June. The high court has previously ruled in favor of Trump's immigration measures during his second term, including upholding the government's authority to turn away asylum seekers during overwhelmed border periods and permitting rapid deportations to third-party countries.

stories.title: لاہور میں ایکسپریس سیمینار، ملک میں بڑھتی ہوئی ذیابیطس پر تشویش کا اظہار
stories.summary:
لاہور کے ایک نجی ہوٹل میں پاکستان سوسائٹی آف انٹرنل میڈیسن اور سرسید کالج آف میڈیکل سائنسز کے زیر اہتمام ایکسپریس میڈیا گروپ کے تعاون سے ایک خصوصی سیمینار منعقد ہوا۔ اس تقریب کے مہمان خصوصی ماہر ذیابیطس پروفیسر ڈاکٹر جاوید اکرم اور دیگر طبی ماہرین تھے جنہوں نے 'ارلی ایکشن آن ڈائبیٹیز' کے موضوع پر تفصیلی گفتگو کی۔

مقررین نے انکشاف کیا کہ ذیابیطس ایک خاموش قاتل بیماری ہے اور پاکستان میں ہر دوسرا شخص اس مرض میں مبتلا ہو چکا ہے، جبکہ حیرت انگیز طور پر 33 فیصد مریضوں کو اس بات کا علم ہی نہیں کہ وہ شوگر جیسی بیماری کا شکار ہیں۔ ماہرین کا کہنا تھا کہ ذیابیطس خود براہ راست اموات کی وجہ نہیں بنتی بلکہ اس کی وجہ سے ہونے والا فالج اور ہارٹ اٹیک انسان کی موت کا پروانہ بنتا ہے۔

پروفیسر ڈاکٹر جاوید اکرم نے اپنے خطاب میں کہا کہ پاکستان شوگر کے مریضوں کی تعداد میں دنیا میں سرفہرست ہے اور اس کا علاج غریب طبقے کے لیے اب انتہائی مہنگا ہو چکا ہے۔ تاہم انہوں نے اس بات پر زور دیا کہ صرف اپنی روزمرہ کی طرز زندگی کو تبدیل کرکے 70 فیصد افراد اس خطرناک مرض سے باآسانی محفوظ رہ سکتے ہیں۔

دیگر معالجین نے بھی عوام میں اس بیماری سے بچاؤ کے لیے شعور بیدار کرنے کی ضرورت پر زور دیا متوازن خوراک، باقاعدگی سے واک اور ورزش کو زندگی کا حصہ بنانے کی تلقین کی۔ اس موقع پر ایڈیٹر فورم اجمل ستار ملک نے ایکسپریس میڈیا گروپ کی جانب سے ایسے اہم سماجی اور صحت سے متعلقہ مسائل پر بیداری پھیلانے کے عزم کو سراہا۔

stories.title: Pakistan Defeats Bangladesh 1-0 to Secure SAFF Championship Final Spot
stories.summary:
Pakistan advanced to the SAFF Championship final after securing a hard-fought 1-0 victory over tournament hosts Bangladesh at the National Stadium in Dhaka. Abdul Samad Arshad scored the winning goal in the 85th minute, shattering Bangladesh's hopes of reaching the final on home soil and setting up a championship clash against arch-rivals India.

The semi-final match remained scoreless through a balanced first half that saw both teams strike the woodwork. Bangladesh threatened early in the seventh minute when Kazem Shah tested the Pakistani goalkeeper, and later came close when a powerful effort from Rakib slipped through the keeper's hands and hit the post. Pakistan also created scoring opportunities before halftime, including an effort by Abdus Samad that hit the post after defender Tariq Kazi lost his marking assignment.

The competitive intensity continued into the second half as Pakistan successfully frustrated the home side's attacks until Arshad broke the deadlock five minutes before regulation time. Despite late pressure and attempts by Bangladesh to find an equalizer, Pakistan maintained their lead to seal the victory and secure their place in the final scheduled for November 17.

Coached by Nolberto Solano, Pakistan reached the semi-finals as the runner-up of Group B, having recovered from an opening 3-2 loss to India with a 3-0 win over the Maldives featuring two goals from teenage striker Najeeb Ullah Khan. The squad was further bolstered ahead of the semi-final by the addition of five overseas-based players—Abdullah Iqbal, Easah Suliman, Ali Akbar Khan, Adil Nabi, and Abdul Samad Shahzad—who had missed the group stage because their availability fell outside the official FIFA international window.

stories.title: US Flights Resume Following Rare Nationwide Ground Stop Causing Chaos
stories.summary:
Flights gradually resumed across the United States on Saturday after a major technical failure in outdated communications infrastructure triggered a rare four-hour nationwide ground stop. The emergency action halted US airspace operations for only the second time since the September 11 terrorist attacks, leaving hundreds of thousands of travelers stranded and causing widespread confusion at airports nationwide.

The Federal Aviation Administration reported that the communications breakdown forced the cancellation of roughly 12,000 flights on Friday. FAA chief Bryan Bedford stated that an additional 4,000 to 5,000 cancellations were expected out of the 41,000 scheduled flights on Saturday as airlines worked to recover. US Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy assured the public that it was safe to fly while acknowledging that normalized operations would take time as carriers repositioned aircraft and flight crews.

Transportation officials attributed the outage to overloaded, decades-old copper lines dating back to the 1980s, emphasizing that there was no evidence of foul play or any connection to a separate Microsoft outage that affected global email and business services earlier in the week. Following the incident, Secretary Duffy called for a $50 billion investment to modernize the nation's aging air traffic control system, while various lawmakers urged immediate investigations into the infrastructure vulnerability.

The shutdown created severe disruptions at major travel hubs, leaving passengers dealing with long queues, rescheduled itineraries, and jammed transportation alternatives as the country approached the busy Thanksgiving holiday period. Airspace operations were restored on Friday evening at 8:15 pm Eastern Time once full functionality at air traffic control facilities was reestablished, though aviation authorities warned that secondary delays and rebooking challenges would likely persist.

stories.title: Artificial Intelligence in Legal Practice Highlights Accountability and Risks
stories.summary:
The integration of artificial intelligence into legal practice is shifting the role of junior associates from drafting documents to verifying outputs, emphasizing that human accountability remains critical. While AI can assist with tasks such as research, initial summaries, and translation, legal experts note that software cannot replace human oversight or assume legal responsibility. In Pakistan, legal frameworks including the Constitution, Code of Civil Procedure, and Pakistan Penal Code hold human signatories accountable for court filings and pleadings, meaning that outsourcing reasoning to a machine does not alter a lawyer's professional obligations.

Concerns regarding AI largely center around hallucinations, wherein models generate plausible-looking but completely fabricated case citations through statistical pattern-matching. This issue is particularly pronounced in jurisdictions like Pakistan, where legal reporting is fragmented and datasets may lack up-to-date statutory amendments. In 2023, an Additional Sessions Judge in Phalia, Muhammad Amir Munir, tested ChatGPT-4 during a bail hearing and caught the tool providing erroneous answers regarding amended statutory age provisions under Section 83 of the Pakistan Penal Code.

Judicial institutions are beginning to establish formal boundaries for AI usage. In March 2025, Supreme Court justices Syed Mansoor Ali Shah and Aqeel Ahmed Abbasi addressed AI risks in a rent dispute judgment, describing hallucinations and recommending national guidelines. Consequently, the National Judicial (Policy Making) Committee approved the National Guidelines for Use of Artificial Intelligence in Judicial Institutions of Pakistan in February 2026. These rules mandate human validation, require users to identify AI-generated text, and prioritize local systems trained on domestic legal data, though they do not directly bind advocates or Bar Councils.

Comparative authorities in other common-law jurisdictions are similarly tightening standards against unverified AI citations. India's Supreme Court adopted a zero-tolerance policy in July 2026, ruling that citing unverified AI precedents constitutes professional misconduct, a principle mirrored by sanctions issued in United States courts. Legal professionals emphasize that as automated tools become more common, lawyers must strictly verify outputs to avoid severe penalties, professional disciplinary actions, and charges of reckless misrepresentation before the courts.

stories.title: Microsoft Confirms Global Service Restoration After Massive Outage
stories.summary:
Technology giant Microsoft announced on Saturday that it successfully restored services to all remaining customers and regions, effectively resolving a massive global outage. The US-based corporation stated that it had finished addressing the root cause of the incident, which previously caused widespread disruptions across public services and businesses globally.

The widespread disruption began on Thursday and affected Microsoft products in at least 74 countries and territories throughout the Americas, Europe, Asia, and Africa, according to monitoring data from Downdetector. The technological failure heavily impacted critical services, including the Outlook email platform, the Teams communication application, and the Copilot artificial intelligence assistant. Consequently, the stoppage created difficulties for healthcare institutions, delayed corporate earnings reports, and left numerous schools struggling with daily communications.

Throughout the event, Microsoft maintained that the issue stemmed from an elevated load on its infrastructure rather than any malicious cyber or artificial intelligence activity. By Friday, the enterprise had reported a broad recovery for several applications and issued a formal apology to its customer base and partners for the inconveniences caused. The latest update on Saturday confirms that recovery efforts are fully complete across all impacted areas.

stories.title: KP Wildlife Department Releases Confiscated Falcons Into Natural Habitat
stories.summary:
The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Wildlife Department successfully returned three confiscated falcons to their natural environment on Saturday. Officials involved in the release initiative included Muhammad Niaz, the Conservator of Wildlife for the Central Circle in Peshawar, alongside Mrs. Manahil Wahab, the Divisional Forest Officer for Wildlife in Peshawar.

The released birds comprised one Peregrine Falcon and one Shaheen Falcon that enforcement personnel confiscated on November 13, 2026. Authorities also included another Peregrine Falcon that was seized the following day, November 14, at the Peshawar Toll Plaza. This conservation effort highlights the Peshawar Wildlife Division's ongoing dedication to wildlife protection and the safe rehabilitation of protected birds.

During the release event, Conservator Muhammad Niaz emphasized that authorities will maintain strict surveillance and vigilance to stop illegal hunting and poaching across the region. He reiterated the department's commitment to safeguarding provincial wildlife resources and warned that individuals caught violating wildlife laws will face strict legal consequences.

stories.title: راولپنڈی میں اینکر پرسن ربیعہ احسن کی ہلاکت، شوہر کا جسمانی ریمانڈ منظور
stories.summary:
پاکستان کے صوبہ پنجاب کے شہر راولپنڈی میں نجی ٹی وی چینل کی پروگرام ہوسٹ اور اینکر پرسن ربیعہ احسن کی موت کے مقدمے میں گرفتار ان کے شوہر کے جسمانی ریمانڈ میں چار روز کی مزید توسیع کر دی گئی ہے۔ سنیچر کے روز ملزم کو سینئر سول جج نصر اللہ وٹو کی عدالت میں پیش کیا گیا، جہاں پولیس کی جانب سے سات دن کی ریمانڈ کی استدعا کی گئی تھی لیکن عدالت نے چار دن کا ریمانڈ منظور کرتے ہوئے ملزم کو پولیس کے حوالے کر دیا۔ عدالت نے حکم دیا ہے کہ اگلی پیشی پر تفتیش کی پیش رفت سے متعلق رپورٹ بھی پیش کی جائے۔

اس سے قبل پولیس کے مطابق ملزم نے اپنے ابتدائی بیان میں یہ دعویٰ کیا تھا کہ ان کی رہائش گاہ پر 30 بور کا پستول صاف کرتے ہوئے یا کپڑے نکالتے وقت حادثاتی طور پر گولی چل گئی تھی جو ربیعہ احسن کی گردن پر لگی اور وہ موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گئیں۔ واقعہ 8 نومبر کو راولپنڈی کے گلشن آباد میں واقع ان کے گھر میں پیش آیا تھا جہاں سے پولیس نے لاش اور پستول برآمد کیا تھا۔ پولیس نے اس ضمن میں مقتولہ کے بھائی خرم احمد کی مدعیت میں تھانہ صدر بیرونی میں دفعہ 302 کے تحت مقدمہ درج کیا تھا اور شوہر کو حتحویل میں لے لیا تھا۔

تاہم مقتولہ کے بھائی اور مقدمے کے مدعی خرم احمد نے بتایا ہے کہ ان کی فیملی بشمول ان کی والدہ اور بہن نے یہ مقدمہ واپس لینے کا فیصلہ کیا ہے کیونکہ ان کے نزدیک یہ ایک حادثہ تھا اور وہ ملزم کو ایک شریف انسان سمجھتے ہیں۔ خرم احمد کے مطابق واقعے کے وقت وہ خود وہاں موجود نہیں تھے لیکن ان کی والدہ، بہن اور گھر کا ملازم گھر میں موجود تھے۔ ان کا کہنا ہے کہ میاں بیوی کے درمیان کوئی پرانا تنازع یا چپقلش نہیں تھی اور پولیس حکام نے بھی انھیں بتایا ہے کہ وہ کسی بھی وقت مقدمہ واپس لے سکتے ہیں۔

دوسری جانب تفتیشی ٹیم کا کہنا ہے کہ ملزم کو پولی گرافک ٹیسٹ کے لیے لاہور لے جایا جائے گا تاکہ اس کے بیانات اور فرانزک شواہد کی سچائی کا تعین کیا جا سکے کیونکہ حتمی قانونی کارروائی فرانزک رپورٹس، پوسٹ مارٹم اور تفتیشی شواہد کی روشنی میں ہی مکمل کی جائے گی۔ ربیعہ احسن 41 سال کی تھیں اور وہ چینل 92 پر عامر متین کے ساتھ پروگرام ’مقابل‘ کی میزبان تھیں۔ ان کی اچانک موت پر صحاورتی برادری اور ساتھیوں نے شدید دکھ اور صدمے کا اظہار کیا ہے۔

stories.title: خیبر پختونخوا کے 124 اسپتالوں کی سولرائزیشن کا فیصلہ، صحت کے شعبے پر بریفنگ
stories.summary:
خیبر پختونخوا کی مشیر صحت جوہر نگار نے پشاور میں ایک بریفنگ کے دوران انکشاف کیا ہے کہ صوبے بھر کے 124 اسپتالوں کو سولرائز کیا جائے گا تاکہ طبی سہولیات کو بہتر بنایا جا سکے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ صوبے کے 25 اضلاع میں اسپتالوں کے طبی آلات کی خریداری پر دو ارب روپے خرچ کیے جائیں گے۔ صوبائی مشیر صحت نے بتایا کہ خیبر پختونخوا میں 200 سے زائد اسپتال برسوں سے بند پڑے ہیں اور صوبے کی چار کروڑ آبادی کے لیے صحت کے شعبے میں 30 ہزار 697 اہلکار تعینات ہیں۔ انہوں نے نشاندہی کی کہ آبادی کے تناسب سے 18 ہزار کے بجائے 64 ہزار بستروں کی اشد ضرورت ہے۔

صحت کے امور پر بات کرتے ہوئے جوہر نگار نے واضح کیا کہ خیبر پختونخوا میں صحت کارڈ کو ختم نہیں کیا جائے گا بلکہ اس میں موجود خامیوں کو دور کیا جائے گا۔ انہوں نے مزید بتایا کہ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے حیات آباد میں بچوں کے اسپتال کے لیے ایک ارب 46 کروڑ 20 لاکھ روپے دینے کا وعدہ کیا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ صوبے کے پانچ ڈویژنوں میں بریسٹ کینسر سینٹرز کے قیام کے لیے وفاقی حکومت کی جانب سے 85 ملین روپے فراہم کیے جائیں گے۔

بریفنگ کے دوران صحت کے شعبے میں درپیش چیلنجز اور اصلاحات کے حوالے سے حکومتی اقدامات پر روشنی ڈالی گئی تاکہ صوبے کے پسماندہ علاقوں اور ضلعی سطح پر مریضوں کو علاج معالجے کی بہتر اور بلاتعطل سہولیات فراہم کی جا سکیں۔ حکومت کی ان ترجیحات کا مقصد صحت کے بنیادی ڈھانچے کو مضبوط بنانا اور عوام کو صحت کی بنیادی سہولیات ان کے قریب ترین مراکز پر مہیا کرنا ہے۔

stories.title: مسلح افواج دشمن کے ناپاک منصوبے ناکام بنانے کی صلاحیت رکھتی ہیں، وزیراعظم
stories.summary:
وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے کہا ہے کہ پاکستان کی مسلح افواج دشمن کے ہر ناپاک منصوبے کو خاک میں ملانے کی بھرپور صلاحیت رکھتی ہیں۔ انہوں نے عزم ظاہر کیا کہ بیرونی سرپرستی میں ہونے والی دہشت گردی کے مکمل خاتمے تک سیکیورٹی فورسز کے آپریشنز پوری قوت کے ساتھ جاری رہیں گے۔ وزیراعظم نے بلوچستان کے علاقوں کولپور، کردگاپ اور نوشکی میں بھارتی سرپرستی میں سرگرم دہشت گرد تنظیم ’فتنہ الہندوستان‘ کے خلاف کامیاب انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشنز پر سیکیورٹی فورسز کو زبردست خراجِ تحسین پیش کیا۔

پاک فوج کے شعبہ تعلقات عامہ (آئی ایس پی آر) کے مطابق خیبر پختونخوا کے علاقے شمالی وزیرستان میں سیکیورٹی فورسز نے کارروائی کرتے ہوئے 16 خارجی دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کر دیا جن میں بھارتی سرپرستی میں کام کرنے والے دو افغان شہری بھی شامل تھے۔ اس کارروائی کے دوران فائرنگ کے شدید تبادلے میں پاک فوج کے دو جوان حوالدار عصمت علی اور نائیک آفتاب علی شہید ہو گئے۔ اس کے علاوہ بلوچستان میں کولپور اور نوشکی کے آپریشنز میں کولپور کے مقام پر مزید 8 دہشت گردوں کو ہلاک کیا گیا۔

اسی دوران فتنہ الہندوستان کے دہشت گردوں نے کوئٹہ تفتان قومی شاہراہ پر گشت کرنے والی فوجی گاڑیوں پر کواڈ کاپٹرز کے ذریعے حملہ کیا جس کے نتیجے میں میجر عمر منہاس ناصر اور حوالدار محمد عدنان خان جامِ شہادت نوش کر گئے۔ وزیراعظم شہباز شریف نے ان شہداء کو شاندار الفاظ میں خراجِ عقیدت پیش کیا۔ قبل ازیں، صدر مملکت آصف علی زرداری اور وزیراعظم شہباز شریف کی لاہور میں ایک اہم ملاقات بھی ہوئی جس میں سیکیورٹی، سیاسی اور معاشی امور پر تفصیلی مشاورت کی گئی۔

stories.title: US Flights Resume After Rare Nationwide Ground Stop Caused by Outage
stories.summary:
Flights across the United States resumed on Saturday after a rare four-hour nationwide ground stop triggered by a major outage in outdated communications systems. The Federal Aviation Administration halted flights following severe air traffic control communication issues, marking only the second time such a stoppage occurred outside of the September 11 attacks. The incident affected more than 20,000 flights, leading to over 3,900 cancellations and 2,500 delays on Saturday alone.

Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy reassured the public that flying remains safe while warning that lingering delays would persist as airlines reschedule flights and reposition crews. Duffy explained that the system relied on 1980s copper lines that became overloaded, emphasizing the urgent need for a $50 billion investment to modernize the air traffic control infrastructure. Lawmakers have since called for investigations into the disruption and national cybersecurity vulnerabilities.

Passengers nationwide faced severe chaos, with crowded terminals, long lines for rental cars, and uncertainty surrounding holiday travel plans. Travelers expressed frustration as flights were repeatedly delayed or canceled at the last minute, though some found alternative ways to reach their destinations. The FAA eventually reopened the airspace after restoring full functionality to its air traffic control facilities.

This stoppage follows a previous failure of a pilot notification system in January 2023, but it remains one of the most disruptive domestic aviation events in recent history. As operations slowly return to normal, officials note that the Thanksgiving holiday rush will further test the resilience of the recovering network.

stories.title: اسرائیلی اپوزیشن رہنما گادی آئزنکوٹ نے نیتن یاہو کی اتحاد کی پیشکش مسترد کردی
stories.summary:
اسرائیل کے سابق آرمی چیف اور وزارت عظمیٰ کے امیدوار گادی آئزنکوٹ نے نگراں وزیراعظم بنجمن نیتن یاہو کی جانب سے قومی اتحاد کی حکومت بنانے کی اپیل کو مسترد کرتے ہوئے اسے ایک سیاسی حربہ قرار دیا ہے۔ انہوں نے ہفتے کے روز بیان دیتے ہوئے کہا کہ نیتن یاہو انتخابات میں شکست کھا چکے ہیں اور وہ معاشرے میں تقسیم اور سیاسی کشیدگی کو ہوا دے رہے ہیں۔ آئزنکوٹ نے مزید کہا کہ نیتن یاہو ایک طرف مذاکرات کی دعوت دے رہے ہیں جبکہ دوسری طرف ان کے اقدامات اختلافات کو مزید بڑھا رہے ہیں۔ انہوں نے واضح کیا کہ وہ نیتن یاہو کی ان سیاسی چالوں سے متاثر نہیں ہوں گے۔

نیتن یاہو کی جانب سے قومی اتحاد کی حکومت بنانے کی یہ اپیل ایسے وقت میں سامنے آئی ہے جب اسرائیل میں انتخابی نتائج اور نئی حکومت کی تشکیل کے لیے سیاسی سرگرمیاں جاری ہیں۔ اس صورتحال سے ظاہر ہوتا ہے کہ ملک میں نئی حکومت کے قیام پر سیاسی جماعتوں کے درمیان اختلافات بدستور برقرار ہیں اور قومی اتحاد کے تصور پر کوئی اتفاق رائے پیدا نہیں ہوسکا ہے۔ آئزنکوٹ کو اس سیاسی عمل میں عرب جماعتوں کے اتحاد جوائنٹ لسٹ کی حمایت بھی حاصل ہے۔

دوسری جانب نیتن یاہو کی طرف سے گادی آئزنکوٹ کے ان تازہ الزامات پر فوری طور پر کوئی ردعمل سامنے نہیں آیا۔ گادی آئزنکوٹ اسرائیلی سیاست میں ایک اہم شخصیت ہیں جو ماضی میں فوج کے سربراہ رہ چکے ہیں اور قومی سلامتی و دفاعی امور پر ان کا گہرا تجربہ انہیں اس سیاسی منظرنامے میں ایک نمایاں مقام دلاتا ہے۔

stories.title: India Edges Pakistan in Thrilling U19 Asia Cup Final
stories.summary:
